basic_info.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models (DreamerV3)
basic_info.affiliation: Google DeepMind (Hafner et al.; not fully confirmed from abstract page)

method.notes: Single fixed hyperparameter configuration working across 150+ tasks (Atari, DMC, Minecraft diamond collection from scratch, etc). This project's Stage 2 directly reuses DreamerV3's documented mechanisms: (1) KL free bits at 1 nat per term, (2) KL balancing L_kl = 0.5*max(1,KL_dyn) + 0.1*max(1,KL_rep) (dynamics loss weighted 5x the representation loss), (3) 1% unimix (uniform mixture floor) on both prior and posterior categorical distributions to prevent any single class from fully saturating, (4) 32 categoricals x 32 classes as the UNIVERSAL default latent size at every model scale from XS to XL (this project's 16x16 was a deliberate down-scale for compute reasons), (5) symlog + MSE for continuous observation reconstruction (not two-hot, which DreamerV3 reserves for reward/value heads only -- this project correctly followed that distinction when rejecting a two-hot GPS head).

gap_analysis.whats_missing: General-purpose model-based RL benchmark paper, not GPS map matching. Confirms P2's RSSM formula but never touches road graphs or GPS trajectories.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Same class as Think2Drive/DreamerV2 -- architectural inspiration for P2, wrong domain; does not pre-empt the thesis's GPS map-matching application.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Primary source-of-truth for Stage 2's exact KL free-bits/balancing formula, unimix, and 32x32-vs-16x16 latent-size default -- every numeric hyperparameter in stage2_correction.md's Changes 1 and 11 is verified against this paper. Also the source confirming that Stage 2's KL treatment (Changes 1/11) implements the formula CORRECTLY, meaning the observed posterior collapse is not a formula bug but a case DreamerV3's own mechanism was never designed to fix (the mechanism targets a lagging/inaccurate prior, not decoder-side channel competition).

uncertain: Exact per-domain hyperparameter table (Table W.1 in the full PDF) was not independently re-verified beyond what this project's prior research pass already extracted; abstract-page fetch could not confirm page-level table contents.
